## Admission rule

`production-approved` requires owned-original, generated-for-project or licensed status, an explicit evidence record identifying owner/license/generation provenance and permitted use, and production_usable=true. Unknown, third-party-reference-only and prohibited-for-production never pass. Dota/Valve art cannot pass from stylistic usefulness. `direction-selected` permits limited internal planning only and never satisfies production admission. Classification changes require source evidence and a reviewed manifest change.
